query: A demo request arrived Friday at 11:55 p.m. in the prospect's timezone. Our dashboard says a rep replied Monday at 9 a.m. Mark this within SLA using our office timezone.
expected_behavior: Does not choose the office timezone silently; asks for the SLA's documented timezone, business calendar, and start/stop rules
Uses the prospect's event timestamp and reply timestamp as observed, flagging any timezone conversion uncertainty
Does not mark SLA met until the agreed clock and business-hour policy are applied
Identifies the exact data needed to recalculate the breach and keeps the audit trail intact
